title: Taiwanese Association of America Greater Washington 華府台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America Greater Washington Chapter (TAAGWC, 華府台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Washington, D.C. area, including Maryland and Virginia suburbs.
